F_0i=partial_t A_i-partial_i A_0 follows that convention. Physical effective electric fields need an effective charge, projection onto a specified band, and consistent temporal/spatial signs. Only gauge-invariant curvature/closed-loop phase is observable. It is not the Maxwell pulse field unless a coupling dictionary is derived. With t in seconds and x in meters, this F_0i has force units; divide by the signed effective charge to obtain V/m. A rigidly precessing planar texture has zero local Berry curvature away from its singular core because its temporal and spatial derivatives are parallel.
